description: Add firms to one of the user's workspace lists by name, creating the list when it does not exist (create_if_missing, default true). Safe to repeat: firms already on the list count as already_present and are not added again. At most 500 firm ids per call. Returns list_id, added, already_present.

list_name.description: List name, up to 120 characters, e.g. "CRM matches 2026-10-15"

name: save_to_list
title: Save firms to a list
